verdict.rationale: The M5 is exposed to developers through programmable APIs (Tensor APIs in Metal 4), so developer API documentation is a fair question for this chip. However, the evidence never mentions an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the llms.txt probe returned 404. Mentions of Metal, Core ML and MLX describe frameworks, not an interactive reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
